schemes.name: FoXS χ² · DOC1monomer–CDK2
schemes.metric_note: FoXS χ² · full CDK2–DOC1 construct (413 residues), reused on this clustering residue view. 5,000/5,910 displayed models have an accepted exact-coordinate-hash match. Mean squared sigma-weighted residual divided by N; lower is better agreement with the DOC1monomer–CDK2 curve. q ≤ 0.42 Å⁻¹; 805 points; IMP/FoXS 2.25.0; optimized c1/c2; no offset. Missing scores are not imputed. This is neither confidence nor a biological-state probability. The older collaborator PDB models have different native hashes from the scored downloaded CIF cohort.

representative_policy: Each row opens a deterministic model from the cluster. Full-length views contain the saved energy-selected representatives, TM similarity, Bonsai and structural states.
mask_note: Fresh fit on CDK2 A1–298 and DOC1 B60–115 (354 residues). DOC1 B1–59 was excluded for all 5,910 models.
clustering_method_note: HDBSCAN leaf on 10D UMAP; minimum cluster size 15, min_samples 11.

core_results.summary: HDBSCAN leaf: 64 trimmed clusters and 2,695 unassigned; full fit: 64 clusters and 2,988 unassigned.
core_results.structures_note: Exact native models are viewable. Structures retain the full construct; the trim applies to clustering.

provenance.coordinate_policy: Exact native coordinate bytes with verified atlas chain mapping.
provenance.score_scope: ProteinEBM scores are reused from the full construct.
